item.title: Effective Note-Taking to Remember More + Create New Ideas
item.description:
Reference: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_t9R1AnB7ho

Note-taking

Understanding and remembering more Combining ideas for more creative ideas

Two steps

  • Literature notes - Things that stood out or interested you (in your own words)

    • Punchy quotes, how you felt,
    • Write in your own words
      • Forces you to think - properly process your thoughts
      • Check yourself - Do you really get it? Do you know what you feel about it? Can you explain it in your own words? Do you get the main idea?
      • Remember more of what you read - Learning is helped by friction (req. effort so it’s an active process)

  • Atomic Notes - Based on Literature Notes but independent (without source context)

item.title: Notes - Brief History & Ethos of the Digital Garden
item.description:
Reference: https://maggieappleton.com/garden-history

Brief History & Ethos of the Digital Garden

Avoiding “personal blog” and more like free-form work-in-progress wikis A collection of evolving ideas not organised by publication Half-finished thoughts that grow and evolve with time “Less perfect” - like the early days of the web

  • WikiGardeners https://wiki.c2.com/?WikiGardener and WikiGnomes - https://wiki.c2.com/?WikiGnome Mike Caulfield coining the term “Digital Gardening” “Campfires” as conversational spaces to exchange still-forming ideas Joel Hooks “My blog is a digital garden” Amy Hoy’s “How the Blog Broke the Web

Is GitHub you digital garden? A space to share ideas, work, files, ect in a semi-structured manner?

item.title: Philosophy
item.description:
Priorities

  • Writing books
  • Discovering, understanding and sharing the universe
  • Create art with people I love
  • Do cool shit with cool people

Comics - Write Mini Essays about these

  • Oatmeal - Plane
  • Oatmeal - Unhappy
  • SMBC - 11 Lives
  • ZP - Just a Ride
  • ZP - Find the others
  • ZP - Fire Within
  • ZP - The Man In The Arena
  • ZP - Because It’s There

Four Agreements

  1. Be impeccable with your word - always be honest, integrity, radical vulnerability
  2. Don’t take anything personally - It’s not about you, Rule of Thirds, Explaining is Draining
  3. Don’t make assumptions - See it as it is, there are no ordinary moments
  4. Always do your best - It alwasy gets better, 80/20 rule, Practice the basics

Principles

item.title: Time Management
item.description:
Use mini keyboard to type before work Productivity

  • Pomodoro, Meditation, speech-to-text, Eat the frog, alarm to go to bed
  • Each evening, plan ahead for the next day. Max 10 things
  • Break down tasks, If it’ll take <5 mins then do it right now,
  • Do what your future self will thank you for, Ask why you don’t want to do a thing
  • Show up every day - It doesn’t matter how I perform, just show up consistently.
  • Practice the basics: Sleep, exercise, diet.
    • Wake up early: First hours of day to myself, then go to work tired
    • Wim Hof - 2min cold shower at the start of the day
    • Set an alarm at night to go to bed
  • Have ADHD Days & Autism Nights
    • Paint WH40k? LEGO?
    • Dream Bigger: Space Jump, Breakthrough Listen, 50 marathons in 50 days, Mini Essay - Ridiculous Bucket List

Meditation
